name: Congenital Cataract-Anterior Segment Dysgenesis Syndrome
aliases: Congenital Cataract with Anterior Segment Dysgenesis
Anterior Segment Dysgenesis with Congenital Cataract

criteria.description: Presence of bilateral or unilateral congenital cataracts
Developmental abnormalities of the anterior segment including iris hypoplasia, corectopia, or corneal opacity
Lack of systemic malformations or syndromic features outside the eye

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of congenital cataract plus at least one anterior segment dysgenesis feature
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis is primarily clinical supported by ophthalmologic examination and exclusion of other syndromes.

pathognomonic.notes: Lens opacity present at birth or early infancy
Displacement of the pupil from its normal central position

common.notes: Clouding of the cornea affecting vision
Shallow or irregular anterior chamber depth
searchTerms: eye structure defects in front chamber

common.notes: Light sensitivity due to anterior segment defects
Involuntary eye movements secondary to visual impairment

occasional.notes: Elevated intraocular pressure due to anterior segment malformations

searchTerms: eye sensitivity to light causing rubbing
light sensitivity leading to eye rubbing

rare.notes: Separation of the retina from underlying tissue
Opacification developing after initial cataract surgery
searchTerms: cloudy lens after surgery or trauma

imaging: Slit-lamp biomicroscopy showing anterior segment abnormalities
Ultrasound biomicroscopy for anterior chamber evaluation
Ocular coherence tomography (OCT) for anterior segment structures
other: Family history of congenital cataracts or anterior segment anomalies

distinguishingFeatures: Central corneal opacity with iridocorneal adhesions
Near complete absence of the iris
Often caused by PAX6 mutations with systemic involvement

redFlags: Rapidly progressive visual loss in infancy
Presence of systemic malformations suggesting syndromic diagnosis
references: OMIM Entry - Congenital Cataract-Anterior Segment Dysgenesis Syndrome
